setting.studio: Personal greeting, explanation detail and accent. Customize them in Caled: My studio → My space. The greeting name stays on this device and is not added to AI requests.
command.edit: Caled: Edit selected code with AI
setting.language: Language of the Caled panel, agent and dialogs. Core editor menus use the editor display language.
setting.appearance: Choose light, dark or system in Caled: Appearance and language to apply the theme to the entire editor.
setting.profile: Five specialized profiles. Guide and Reviewer cannot edit or run commands. Only one task runs at a time.
setting.accountUrl: Optional Supabase project HTTPS URL for accounts. Local AI works without signing in.
setting.accountKey: Public publishable/anon key only. Never enter a service-role key or an OAuth secret.
